data.name: Hotel Casa Doña Susana by Los Arcos Puerto Vallarta
data.address: Manuel M. Dieguez 171, Zona Romántica, Emiliano Zapata, 48380 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
Set a 2-minute walk from the town's boardwalk and the nearest beach on the Pacific coast, this upscale hacienda-style hotel for adults only is also 12 km from the animal exhibits at Zoologico de Vallarta.
The polished rooms feature hand-carved wood furnishings and Mexican folk art. All provide free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, minibars and safes. Suites include sitting areas, and upgraded suites add kitchenettes and furnished balconies.
Parking is complimentary. Amenities include a restaurant, 2 bars (1 poolside) and a snack bar. There's also an outdoor pool, a spa and a terrace. Butler service is offered.
